{{Top}}
'''Hanava''' was a type of fruit [[Tree/Legends|tree]] whose wood was a primary food source for the [[Greddleback termite/Legends|greddleback termite]]. A shipment of hanava fruit which was smuggled to [[Bethal]] contained a small number of greddlebacks. Once on the new planet, however, the termites ravaged the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[apocia]] tree population.
